turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning, Orion Shield Insurance, Rahul speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, water is coming through my ceiling and I'm really worried about the damage.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Ah, that sounds really frustrating. Let's see what we can do. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Fatima Khan, 24 October 1992.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's KM2 6LF.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had a water leak at home and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me exactly what happened, and when it happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It started about an hour ago. The pipe under the kitchen sink burst and water's gone across the whole floor.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Was anyone injured, and how extensive is the damage?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Everyone's safe, but the floor and the bottom of the cabinets are soaked and some electrics are close by.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And can you confirm the address of the property?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 14 Larch Avenue.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, you'll pay an excess, which is the part of any claim you cover yourself, and if someone else was at fault we may recover the costs from their insurer.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Surely you can approve the repair costs right now though?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 1:17]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. Because it's an emergency you can arrange an urgent repair yourself, up to $500, without needing our approval first. Just keep every receipt.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Right, I see.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. Someone will get back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the home claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
